data.description:
## Goal (user story)

As the ToneForge build owner, I want `cli.marketplace.integration.test.ts > a new
process renders an installed recipe deterministically (AC1, AC2, AC4)` to pass
**deterministically under full-suite parallel load**, so a red suite always
signals a real regression instead of scheduler contention.

## Failure signature

- Test: `src/cli.marketplace.integration.test.ts` > `a new process renders an installed recipe deterministically (AC1, AC2, AC4)`
- Observed signature (auto-triage): `load-induced timeout/spawn failure`
- Filed: 2026-10-18T17:36Z by the automated triage step of a full-suite run
- Failing commit: not captured by triage; the test itself was introduced by
  `15638a0` — `TF-0MV13N9GI0060F8E: Implementation complete`

## Evidence: root cause (from cached full-suite runs)

The test runs **three sequential CLI child processes**, each cold-booting the
CLI from source (`bin/dev-cli.js` registers `tsx`, then imports
`src/cli.yargs.ts`):

1. `marketplace install ui_chimes@1.0.0 --json`
2. `generate --recipe ui-chime --seed 42 --output a.wav --json`
3. `generate --recipe ui-chime --seed 42 --output b.wav --json`

Timing budget: the Vitest global `testTimeout` is **20 000 ms**
(`vitest.config.ts`, raised from 5 s for exactly this kind of spawn-heavy test),
while `test/run-yargs-child.ts` allows **30 000 ms per spawn** and this test sets
no per-test timeout. Three cold spawns therefore consume almost the whole test
budget under heavy concurrent load. Durations for this test across 21 cached
full-suite runs:

- **Median: 7.8 s** — normally fast
- **Max: 19.2 s** — the most recent recorded full run (2026-10-18 20:42), only
  0.8 s from the 20 s timeout limit
- **4 of 21 runs ≥ 13.5 s** — the upper tail (10-16 08:19, 17:27, 18:19, 2026-10-18 20:42)
  shows the duration can spike dramatically under heavy parallel load

The failure at 17:36 on 2026-10-18 is consistent with this pattern: under heavy
scheduler contention the test exceeded the 20 s timeout. The sibling test
`a new process renders an installed stack (AC1, AC4)` (two spawns) sits at 11.5 s
in the same cached run and is the next to cross the line.

### Alternatives considered

- **Mock the CLI subprocess** — rejected: it destroys the cross-process
  guarantee these tests exist to prove (TF-0MV13N9GI0060F8E).
- **Raise the global `testTimeout` / reduce workers** — rejected as the primary
  fix: it hides the systemic cost across every test and lengthens real-hang
  detection.
- **Targeted per-test timeout on the multi-spawn cases** — chosen: it keeps the
  cross-process guarantee and matches existing precedent
  (`src/stack/renderer.test.ts` uses `}, 60_000);` for spawn-heavy tests).

## Steps to reproduce

This reproduces only under full-suite parallel load. In isolation or under low
load the test takes ~7.8 s median and always passes.

1. Check out the latest `dev`.
2. Run the full suite through the test skill:
   `/skill:test` (equivalently `python3 skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py --scope full`).
3. Confirm the failure mode in the run log: the test is reported as timed out at
   20 000 ms with **no assertion failure**, and its reported duration from a
   nearby passing run is within a second of 20 000 ms.

## Impact

Critical-priority triage item, but the failure is a harness-level flake, not a
product regression (no product defect is evidenced by any cached run). It turns
full-suite runs red without cause, blocks the `dev` push gate, and burns a
triage cycle each time it fires.

## Proposed fix (minimal end-to-end slice)

1. Add an explicit per-test timeout to the multi-spawn tests in
   `src/cli.marketplace.integration.test.ts` — at minimum the recipe-determinism
   test and the sibling stack test (`}, 60_000);`).
2. Hoist the value into a named constant with a comment recording the reason
   (three cold `tsx` CLI spawns can exceed 19 s under heavy parallel load;
   ~3× headroom).
3. Verify with a full-suite run (`/skill:test --scope full`): the test passes and
   its duration sits well below its configured timeout.
4. Do **not** change product code — no product defect has been evidenced.

## Key Files

- `src/cli.marketplace.integration.test.ts` — the failing test; add the per-test timeouts.
- `test/run-yargs-child.ts` — CLI child-process helper (30 s per-spawn default; unchanged unless evidence says otherwise).
- `vitest.config.ts` — global `testTimeout` and its load-related comment; the reference point for sizing the new per-test timeout.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Root cause is recorded on this work item with evidence (cached-run duration
   table, the 20 s `testTimeout` vs the three-cold-spawn cost) and the fix is
   confined to the test harness — no product-code change.
2. `cli.marketplace.integration.test.ts > a new process renders an installed
   recipe deterministically (AC1, AC2, AC4)` passes in a full-suite run against
   the latest `dev` (verified via `/skill:test --scope full`), and its reported
   duration is at most 50 % of its configured per-test timeout, so the flake
   cannot recur under comparable load.
3. The sibling multi-spawn test `a new process renders an installed stack (AC1, AC4)`
   gets the same targeted timeout treatment (same root cause; 11.5 s in the same
   cached run).
4. Any harness documentation touched by the fix (test-file header comment,
   timeout-constant comment, or the `vitest.config.ts` comment) reflects the new
   behaviour; no user-facing documentation change is required because no product
   behaviour changes.
5. Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Out of scope

- The other load-induced timeout items filed from the same batch run
  (`TF-0MVE3XFZ5005TPHP`, `TF-0MVE3XSRH008R3YW`, `TF-0MVE3Y3AG0016TUC`,
  `TF-0MVE3YK580008IVP`, `TF-0MVE3YXLK001Z4WX`) — same systemic pattern, tracked
  independently; this item covers the marketplace suite only.
- Changing the global `testTimeout`, the worker count, or the test-skill
  scheduler.

## Related work

- `TF-0MV13N9GI0060F8E` (completed) — introduced the cross-process discovery
  tests, including the failing case.
- `TF-0MUZX3ZU3008FQH3` (completed) — `docs/guides/marketplace.md` CLI contract
  tests that share this file.
- Parent `TF-0MVDQP78X007OZNA` — auto-triage attached this item as a child of the
  epic that was being implemented when the failure occurred; the test itself
  concerns the marketplace CLI, not that epic. Re-parenting is a producer
  decision and is deliberately not done here.

## Links

- Triage runbook: `skill/triage/resources/runbook-test-failure.md`
